notes: paths: src/**/*.tsx
enforced: jscpd with threshold 0 in pnpm check (pnpm dup).
covers all of projects/follow-the-packet, project README included; spec and plan stay in Spanish in the repo-root docs/
display language Spanish, no i18n layer: Spanish text in src/copy/ and in level files
deviation: the engine returns reason codes and src/copy/ renders them in Spanish
pnpm (pnpm-lock.yaml, packageManager pnpm@11.3.0); pnpm runs no dependency install script unless allowed in pnpm-workspace.yaml

deviation: boundaries use core no-restricted-imports generated from the layer table instead of eslint-plugin-boundaries (no extra dependency or alias resolver)

deviation: the end-to-end tests have a second alias, @e2e/ -> tests/e2e/ (in tsconfig.json), so a spec in a subfolder of tests/e2e/ imports the shared helpers without ../; nothing in src/ imports it. Local to this project, not a generic rule
covers src/ and tests/; suffixes *.test.ts, *.test.tsx, *.spec.ts; no exemptions
enforced: eslint-plugin-check-file on src/ and tests/ in pnpm lint.
